data.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI and software systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML/software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise and confident client-facing skills.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML and software systems

  • Designing and building production-grade ML/software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

Who we're looking for:

  • You possess strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one compiled or strongly-typed language (e.g. Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript), and know how to build robust, production-grade systems.

  • You bring deep expertise in software engineering and strong Python skills, focusing on building robust, reusable systems

  • You have demonstrable hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture, security, and infrastructure

  • You've extensive experience working with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, demonstrating ownership and autonomy in driving projects to completion

  • You communicate exceptionally well, confidently guiding both technical teams and senior, non-technical stakeholders

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. data.description:
UK | Full-Time

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

  • 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

  • True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

The Cultural Anchor: Own It

We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership:

"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”

The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O

We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.

What You’ll Work On

  • System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.

  • Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.

  • Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.

  • Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.

  • Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for.

  • Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.

  • Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone.

  • Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.

  • Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness

  • Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.

 

A Note on Our Search

We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.

Why Join Source.dev?

  • AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices.

  • Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.

  • Early-Stage Ownership: You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one.

  • Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers.

  • Elite Engineering Culture: Join a high-trust & passionate team of engineers

About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is launching a Professional Services organization to accelerate customer success, reduce time-to-value, and drive enterprise adoption for agentic workloads. As a Principal Solution Architect, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling this function. You will join a team of seasoned experts with deep experience backed by Docker's unmatched reach across Fortune 500 companies.

This is a high-visibility role working directly with senior leadership across revenue, product, marketing, and partner organizations. You'll shape service strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver offerings that accelerate both services revenue and platform expansion.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to our largest and most strategic partners and enterprise customers, providing thought leadership on integrating Docker agentic solutions within enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

Build and Scale the Professional Services Practice

  • Develop and codify repeatable reference architecture patterns across Docker's core use cases including self-hosted and air-gapped deployments, MCP (model context protocol)/AI agent environments, IDP integrations, and secure supply chain workflows so that engagements scale consistently across customers and partners.

We are hiring a Finance Transformation Lead to drive the modernization of the finance function. You will be the finance change agent and program owner across our biggest foundational bets: ERP implementation, process automation, a 5-day close, controllership and SOX-lite, and standardized data and dashboards.

This is a senior, cross-functional leadership role for someone who has run large finance transformations before. You will act as the finance PMO and process architect, reporting to the CFO and working across the entire finance organization and its advisors. You should be ready tomanage multiple complex workstreams, have an analytical mind, pay keen attention to detail, and love to get your hands dirty.


What you'll do:

ERP program ownership

  • Own the finance side of the ERP program (with system integrators and/or ERP vendors) from BRD through design decisions, data migration, parallel run, and cutover — including alignment with external auditors on post-cutover reporting.
  • Act as Airalo’s primary counterpart to the SI and other delivery partners, holding them to quality, pace, and commercial outcomes.
  • Lead design decisions across the finance value chain (revenue recognition incl. deferred revenue, breakage, rewards; COGS and inventory accounting; intercompany; multi-entity consolidation; period-end close; treasury; tax; AP).
  • Own the transformation roadmap and governance (SteerCo), manage stakeholders and dependencies, and drive adoption and training so change sticks.

    • Process redesign & controllership

  • Engineer and automate the core finance processes (O2C, P2P, R2R, FP&A), eliminate manual effort, and drive a shorter month-end close.
  • Own the data migration strategy, including chart of accounts design, master data ownership, and cutover balances.
  • Drive the design of the future-state finance operating model across group entities, including roles, controls, segregation of duties, and approval workflows.

    • Data, reporting & decision-making

  • Deliver standardized dashboards and driver-based forecasting (toward a ±5% accuracy target), with a single source of truth.
  • Embed finance in the company’s key decision forums.

    • Program & change management

  • Define and track the efficiency, accuracy, and cost benefits of the transformation.
  • Report progress to leadership and the Audit & Risk Committee.
  • Embed AI and automation opportunities into the design (close acceleration, anomaly detection, reconciliations, reporting) rather than treating them as an afterthought.

    • What you'll bring:
  • 10+ years in finance with a clear track record of leading large-scale finance transformation.
  • Has led an ERP implementation end to end as the finance lead (SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics).
  • Deep process re-engineering and automation experience across O2C, P2P, R2R, and FP&A.
  • Strong controllership and controls background (SOX / SOX-lite, ITGC, audit readiness).
  • Program and change-management discipline; can run a multi-workstream roadmap with external advisors and internal stakeholders.
  • Qualified accountant (CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA) and/or a Big 4 / consulting transformation background.
  • Influence and credibility with senior stakeholders inside and outside finance.

    • Preferred experience

  • Prior exposure to telecom, MVNO, SaaS, marketplace or other usage-based / partner-settlement revenue models.
  • Experience embedding AI / automation into finance processes (close, controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Familiarity with modern data/BI tooling (e.g., dbt, BigQuery, BI dashboards) and finance data architecture.
  • Multi-entity, multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction experience; M&A integration a plus.

😎 Our Culture
Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture.  We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.  

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.  

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

🚀About the Role

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer (EMEA) at Quantum Metric, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor supporting complex, high-value sales opportunities across the region. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.

In this role, you will guide the technical strategy for enterprise deals, aligning Quantum Metric’s platform with strategic business initiatives. You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.


🔧 Responsibilities

  • Strategic Advisory: Guide the technical strategy for enterprise sales cycles across EMEA, from initial discovery to closing.

  • Solution Design: Create tailored demonstrations and narratives that align Quantum Metric’s platform with high-level business outcomes.

  • POC Execution: Lead complex proof-of-concepts, defining success criteria and quantifying measurable business value.

  • Technical Architecture: Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures and clear value propositions.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives on deal orchestration and coordinate with Product/Engineering to ensure smooth post-sales onboarding.

  • Market Influence: Support RFP responses and provide structured customer feedback to influence the product roadmap.

  • Linguistic Skills: Proficiency in English and Italian; additional European languages preferred.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and ROI-based solutioning.

  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills tailored for diverse corporate environments.

  • Agility: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple strategic deals and a willingness to travel 25–30% across EMEA.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Digital Experience Analytics or CXM platforms.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI, enterprise data architecture, or tagging strategies.

  • Background in high-growth SaaS or digital transformation consulting.

Providing a simplified approach to monitor, diagnose and optimize the digital journeys that matter most, the Quantum Metric platform offers in-depth customer understanding, quantified and tied to core business objectives.

Monster Jam is the world’s premier monster truck entertainment property, delivering unforgettable live events, iconic trucks, and family experiences to millions of fans around the globe. As the brand continues to expand across Europe, we are seeking a dynamic Franchise Manager to lead integrated growth initiatives spanning marketing, consumer products, retail partnerships, and toy/category development. 

The Senior Director, International Global Partnerships, will lead the strategic growth of the Monster Jam brand across key European markets through integrated franchise marketing, retail activation, consumer products expansion, and cross-functional partnership management. This role is responsible for building cohesive programs that drive brand awareness, increase toy and merchandise penetration, strengthen retailer relationships, and ultimately accelerate event attendance and ticket sales.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded brand builder with experience managing entertainment, toy, sports, family, or lifestyle franchises across multiple territories. This individual will work closely with the Monster Jam consumer products team, regional promoters, retail partners, regional licensees and the Spin Master toy organization to create coordinated campaigns that put Monster Jam products into the hands of consumers while amplifying engagement with the brand within all franchise touchpoints including the live event business.


Essential Functions

Franchise & Brand Marketing

  • Develop and execute the European franchise growth strategy for Monster Jam across key markets and retail channels.
  • Lead integrated marketing initiatives that increase awareness, fan engagement, and affinity for the Monster Jam brand.
  • Partner with regional event, marketing, and ticketing teams to align campaigns that drive attendance and revenue growth.
  • Create scalable promotional programs that connect consumer products, retail activations, digital marketing, and live events.
  • Identify market-specific opportunities to grow audience reach, including localized campaigns, partnerships, and experiential activations.
  • Serve as a steward of the Monster Jam brand across all consumer-facing touchpoints.

    • Consumer Products & Licensing

  • Support the expansion of the Monster Jam consumer products business throughout Europe.
  • Identify opportunities for new product categories, retail exclusives, promotions, and licensing partnerships.
  • Collaborate with internal licensing and consumer products stakeholders to maximize shelf presence and category performance.
  • Analyze market trends, retail performance, and consumer insights to inform product and franchise strategies.
  • Develop annual plans and commercial initiatives that support long-term franchise growth.

    • Retail Partnerships & Programs

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with major European retailers and distribution partners.
  • Develop retail marketing programs that elevate visibility, support product launches, and drive sell-through.
  • Partner with retailers on seasonal campaigns, in-store activations, sweepstakes, promotions, and event tie-ins.
  • Coordinate retailer-specific marketing assets, promotional calendars, and execution plans.
  • Monitor retail performance metrics and identify opportunities to optimize programs and increase market penetration.

    • Spin Master Partnership Management

  • Act as the primary liaison with the Spin Master toy team across Europe and North America for product development for regional needs.
  • Partner closely on go-to-market planning, product launches, marketing campaigns, and retail initiatives.
  • Communicate regional market insights, fan trends, and retailer feedback to support product development and commercial planning.
  • Drive initiatives that increase toy awareness, distribution, and consumer adoption across Europe.
  • Champion the shared vision of placing a Monster Jam toy in every child’s hands to fuel broader franchise engagement and live event attendance.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing, events, ticketing, licensing, finance, and operations, to ensure alignment across all franchise initiatives.
  • Lead project timelines, campaign execution, and stakeholder communication across multiple markets and partners.
  • Present business updates, market insights, and growth opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Manage agency and external partner relationships where applicable.

    • Job Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Entertainment Management, or related field.
  • 5–8+ years of experience in franchise marketing, brand management, consumer products, licensing, retail marketing, or related fields.
  • Experience working with entertainment, toy, sports, gaming, family, or lifestyle brands preferred.
  • Strong understanding of European retail landscapes and consumer markets.
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional partnerships and external stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with major retailers and consumer products organizations.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate brand strategy into measurable business growth.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects across international markets in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe and internationally as needed.

    • Success Metrics

  • Growth in Monster Jam brand awareness across European markets.
  • Increased consumer products and toy sales performance.
  • Expansion and effectiveness of retail partnerships and promotional programs.
  • Measurable contribution to event attendance and ticket sales growth.
  • Successful execution of integrated franchise marketing initiatives.
  • Strengthened collaboration and strategic alignment with the Spin Master partnership team.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

We are looking for a Senior Technical Accountant to join our growing Finance function, reporting to the Head of Technical Accounting. You’ll provide technical accounting support for ongoing business activities, new products and other initiatives, and play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s work, from accounting policy assessments to horizon scanning, audit engagement and the annual report. Strong stakeholder management is key to this role. 

The demands on the Finance team are high as Zopa grows at pace, so you’ll need to build effective and influential relationships within Finance and the wider business. Our team are self-starting problem solvers who are agile and thrive on bringing past experiences and networks to a diverse range of challenges. You’ll be part of an impressive Zopa team, who are super collaborative and happy to roll their sleeves up and get involved in whatever needs doing to achieve their goals. 


A day in the life

  • Carry out technical accounting assessments for new transactions, products, significant contracts and other business initiatives, and draft clear accounting papers and memos. 

  • Play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s ownership of the annual report and accounts, drafting parts of the report and coordinating other sections written by teams across Finance and the wider business, and helping to bring them together into the final report. 

  • Manage stakeholders effectively and work well with other Zopa teams, including Product, Legal, Treasury and Risk, building strong, influential relationships and giving clear, practical technical accounting advice. 

  • Support the development, implementation and upkeep of accounting policies and the accounting manual and give practical guidance on how policies should be applied across the business. 

  • Help put new accounting treatments into practice: make sure finance systems and processes are set up to support new activities, embed them into business-as-usual (BAU) processes and hand them over to the BAU teams. 

  • Support the technical accounting for balance sheet activity, including SPPI testing and hedge accounting assessments and documentation under IAS 39 and IFRS 9. 

  • Support the timely and accurate delivery of month-end reporting where needed. 

  • Work directly with the external auditors on accounting policy and technical accounting matters, answering queries and providing evidence and papers. 

  • Carry out horizon scanning of new and proposed legislation, regulation and accounting standards that affect financial and corporate reporting, prepare impact assessments, and highlight high-impact or high-risk changes. 

  • Help shape and deliver our work to automate the production of the annual report, an area where this role will be fundamental. 

  • Look for ways to use AI and automation to improve technical accounting, policy and reporting processes, and put them into practice. 

  • Keep up to date with developments in financial and corporate reporting. 


About you:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with relevant post-qualification experience. 

  • Experience of working in the financial services sector (ideally banking or consumer finance), or trained at a top six accountancy firm with financial services experience in a technical accounting role. 

  • Solid working knowledge of IFRS and how it applies to financial services products and transactions. 

  • Clear written communication, with experience of drafting technical accounting papers or memos and explaining complex accounting to non-accountants. 

  • A questioning mindset, and the ability to drive change to systems and processes to improve efficiency. 

  • A team player and problem solver. You’ll show great initiative to listen, analyse, research, investigate and provide solutions to problems relating to financial accounting and reporting. 

  • Comfortable managing several pieces of work at once in a fast-moving environment, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels. 

  • Curious about AI and how you can use it in your everyday work. 

  • Motivated, energetic and passionate about excellence and innovation. 


Bonus points for

  • Technical knowledge of IFRS 9 (expected credit losses, EIR), hedge accounting (IFRS 9 and IAS 39), IFRS 2 (share-based payments), and IAS 38 (intangible assets). 

  • Experience of operational accounting. 

#LI-LK1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

 

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

 

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate!

You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving.

You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate.

You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat.

What Can You Expect?

  • Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack.

  • Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting.

  • Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation.

  • Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest.

  • Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day.

  • Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate.

  • Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly.

  • Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible.

About You

  • You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs.

  • You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before.

  • You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making.

  • You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts.

  • You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

  • Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

  • Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

Why join Happl

  • Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people

  • Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have

  • Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together

  • Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work

  • Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape

  • Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing

  • Dental insurance, including family cover

  • A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked

  • A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you

  • Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term

About the Interview

  • Stage 1: 20-min Intro call with Ben Shorrock (Head of Operations)

  • Stage 2: Short task

  • Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops)

Additional Details

  • Location: London, Holborn

  • Team: Finance

  • Reports to: CEO

  • Working arrangement: Hybrid (4+ Days in Office)

📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes Facility et Operations ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

  • les clients majeurs.

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Job Title: Software Engineer - B2B Lending & Payments
Type: Full-time
Location: Paris
 
 
What about us?

Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.

At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.

By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.

Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 

The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer (B2B Lending & Payments) to take ownership of the financial infrastructure that powers how our clients finance their assets through INFINIT.

We believe the most resilient lending and payment systems are built by engineers who operate at the intersection of deep technical mastery, genuine product judgment, and direct proximity to the client’s financing workflow. This is not a ticket-execution role. You will work with business stakeholders and clients to understand why a problem matters before deciding what to build then use agentic coding to ship the how fast and well.

Partnering with other engineers owning this domain, you will own two deeply connected responsibilities. First, crafting the best possible experience for a client going through a loan application, from the moment they submit a request to the moment financing is confirmed, every step should feel clear, fast, and trustworthy. Second, ensuring that every payment executed throughout the loan lifecycle (interest accruals, supplier disbursements, reimbursement) is processed correctly, securely, and without exception. Third, supporting the physical audit and due diligence workflows that allow us to maintain control over the collateral throughout the life of the loan.

You will be the person the rest of the team pings when something in this domain breaks.


What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Expert C# & .NET Engineering, mastery of the .NET ecosystem with a focus on building high-performance, distributed backend systems. You have a proven track record of shipping scalable, production-grade architectures where technical clarity and long-term maintainability are the default.

  • Core banking & ledger logic, a strong professional background in regulated financial environments. You understand the mechanics of ledgers, loan origination, and payment execution and the cost of getting any of it wrong.

  • Mission-critical ownership: Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end. You don't just "write code"; you analyze customer financing workflows, define rigorous technical requirements, and take full accountability for the reliability of every transaction you process.

  • Highly effective stakeholder communication, capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders (customers, product managers) and clearly translating business objectives into prioritized engineering tasks.

  • Practical experience leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve significantly accelerated development velocity while rigorously upholding code quality standards.

About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap, la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte, dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.
🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics. On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique. Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.


👥L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data). Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations.

L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.


💪 Tes missions

Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

  • Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel.
  • Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.
  • Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).
  • Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses.
  • Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

👀 Comment on travaille
  • Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite.
  • Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue.
  • Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance.
  • Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains.
  • L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence.
  • Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte.

    • ⭐ Notre stack
    • GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker
    • Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery
    • Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary
    • IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions
    • Langages : Python, SQL, Docker
    • IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

    🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche

    Indispensable

    • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production.
    • SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût).
    • Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts.
    • Python de qualité, testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique.
    • Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien.
    • Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit.
    • Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble, et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues.
    • Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote.
    • Anglais B2 minimum.

      • Un gros plus

      • Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership.
      • Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries).

        • Un plus

        • Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm.
        • Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills).
        • Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom).
        • Pipelines data en Change Data Capture.
        • Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte.

    🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un rôle au cœur d'une AI-first scale-up fintech FT120, €145M levés, 8 000+ clients, 6 pays.
    • Une Data Platform avec un vrai scope stratégique (reporting, IA, data gouvernance) et des sujets de fond pour les 2 prochaines année.
    • Rémunération : 60K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • Full remote  — venues à Lyon ponctuelles pour les moments d'équipe.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).
    • Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).
    • Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib / EGYM wellpass, et plus.

    ⏳ Process de recrutement
    1. Screening avec notre Senior Talent Acquisition — 45 min sur ton parcours et ta motivation.
    2. 1er entretien technique avec Pauline (Head of Data) — discussion technique, challenge sur la manière d'aborder des problèmes, cadrage de sujets, use case Agicap — 1h.
    3. 2ème entretien technique avec Kévin (Team Lead DE) et Julien — test SQL + test d'architecture oral + discussion technique + cas IA — 2h.
    Feedback rapide à chaque étape. Process transparent, pas de piège.
    AGICAP s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité!

Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.

This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.

À propos de Scento

Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté.

Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. Sur Scento.com, les ventes mensuelles de décants de septembre 2026 représentaient 3,2 fois celles de janvier 2026. Selon Scento, plus de 3 millions de décants de parfum sont vendus chaque année, soit environ un toutes les 10 secondes. En novembre 2025, Scento a annoncé un investissement de 25 millions d'euros sur trois ans dans la découverte du parfum en Europe.

Le poste

L'acquisition payante est l'un des principaux moteurs de croissance de Scento. Nous vendons des décants de parfum de créateurs et de niche à des clients répartis sur 27 marchés européens, avec des budgets mensuels importants à placer sur Meta, Google et de nouveaux canaux.

En tant que Senior Performance Marketing Manager, vous êtes responsable de la performance de ces comptes. Le succès, c'est un CAC maîtrisé, un délai de retour sur investissement qui respecte nos objectifs, et une capacité à identifier vite ce qu'il faut arrêter et ce qu'il faut amplifier.

Vos missions

  • Vous pilotez et faites monter en puissance les comptes Meta et Google de Scento (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Advantage+) sur les marchés européens.
  • Vous gérez budgets, enchères, structure de compte et tests, au regard d'objectifs de CAC et de délai de retour.
  • Vous briefez et testez les créations avec l'équipe marque, lisez la donnée créative et décidez vite d'arrêter ou d'amplifier.
  • Vous veillez à la santé du tracking avec l'analytics et la data (Conversions API, conversions avancées, GA4).
  • Vous ouvrez de nouveaux marchés et de nouveaux canaux, comme TikTok et Microsoft Ads, quand les chiffres le justifient.

Votre profil

  • Plus de 6 ans d'acquisition payante en e-commerce, avec de gros budgets mensuels.
  • Une expertise approfondie de Meta Ads et de Google Ads, et de solides compétences en tableurs et en analytics.
  • Une expérience sur plusieurs pays européens.
  • Un anglais courant ; le français ou l'allemand est un plus.

Ce que nous proposons

  • Une rémunération située dans le haut du marché, complétée par une prime annuelle sur performance.
  • Du télétravail possible partout dans l'UE, avec des bureaux à Paris (place Vendôme) et à Berlin.
  • Une généreuse allocation mensuelle de parfums pour explorer l'ensemble du catalogue.
  • Un budget de formation personnel de 2 500 € par an (cours, conférences, livres).
  • Le matériel de votre choix et un budget d'aménagement de votre espace de travail.
  • Une vraie autonomie et des décisions rapides, dans une entreprise qui se développe vite à travers l'Europe.

Rémunération et candidature

Rémunération : de 95 000 € à 125 000 € brut par an, en CDI à temps plein, plus une prime annuelle sur performance.

Lieu : Paris ou Berlin, ou en télétravail depuis toute l'Union européenne.

À propos de PropertyOS

PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique.

Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier.

Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat.

🚀 Votre mission

En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution.

Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre :

  • Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative.
  • Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition.
  • Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS.
  • Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel.
  • Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés.

Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté.

💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats

Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance.

La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus.

Le principe : valoriser concrètement les opportunités commerciales qui contribuent au développement de PropertyOS.

Les conditions précises de rémunération, les modalités d'attribution des ventes et les échéances de paiement seront communiquées avant le démarrage du partenariat.

Il s'agit d'une opportunité de collaboration indépendante, et non d'un emploi salarié. Aucun revenu minimum ni volume de ventes garanti n'est annoncé.

🎯 Le profil recherché

Nous sommes ouverts à différents parcours professionnels. Vous pourriez correspondre à ce partenariat si vous :

  • Avez une fibre commerciale et aimez créer des relations professionalnelles.
  • Vous intéressez à l'immobilier, aux logiciels SaaS ou aux nouvelles technologies.
  • Savez identifier des opportunités et communiquer clairement.
  • Faites preuve d'autonomie, de sérieux et de professionnalisme.
  • Souhaitez développer une activité indépendante en complément ou à titre principal.

Une expérience préalable dans la vente de logiciels ou l'immobilier est appréciée, mais n'est pas indispensable.

🌿 D'abord, quelques mots sur nous

Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin.

Ce sont ceux qui nous invitent à découvrir un territoire autrement, à prendre le temps, à rencontrer ceux qui y vivent et à profiter pleinement de ce que la nature nous offre.

C'est autour de cette idée que j'ai créé Nature Occitane en 2012.

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés qui imagine, conçoit et organise des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités, en liberté ou accompagnés.

De la Provence à la Catalogne, du canal du Midi aux Cévennes, nous aimons les beaux tracés, les bonnes adresses, les rencontres authentiques et les expériences dont nos voyageurs se souviennent longtemps.

Nous aimons aussi travailler avec des partenaires locaux, défendre un tourisme plus respectueux des territoires et imaginer des voyages qui donnent envie de partir autrement.

Nature Occitane a grandi, et nous avons encore beaucoup d'idées pour la suite : de nouvelles destinations, de nouveaux séjours, des voyages bas carbone en Europe et l'envie de devenir une référence du slow tourisme.

Pour écrire cette prochaine étape, nous recherchons une personne qui aura envie de s'investir pleinement dans notre aventure.

🚀 Votre fiche de poste

1. Vous serez avant tout sur le terrain commercial.

  • Conseiller nos voyageurs et leur proposer les séjours qui leur correspondent.

  • Construire des devis, assurer les relances et concrétiser les réservations.

  • Piloter notre activité commerciale avec des indicateurs simples : ventes, taux de transformation, chiffre d'affaires et marges.

  • Faire évoluer nos méthodes pour améliorer l'expérience client et notre efficacité.

2. Vous ferez grandir notre petite équipe commerciale.

  • Accompagner et faire progresser une collaboratrice.

  • Organiser les priorités et fluidifier le suivi des demandes.

  • Partager vos bonnes pratiques, encourager les initiatives et cultiver l'entraide.

  • Installer une dynamique à la fois exigeante, positive et tournée vers les résultats.

3. Vous participerez activement à notre développement marketing.

Nous lançons un nouveau site internet et souhaitons accélérer notre visibilité.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • Développer notre référencement naturel (SEO), avec environ une journée dédiée chaque semaine.

  • Piloter nos campagnes publicitaires Google Ads avec notre prestataire.

  • Améliorer nos pages séjours et notre parcours de réservation.

  • Participer aux newsletters, aux contenus et aux actions de fidélisation.

  • Identifier les meilleures opportunités pour attirer de nouveaux voyageurs.

4. Vous garderez un pied dans la création de voyages.

Parce que chez nous, la vente et la production sont intimement liés.

Vous pourrez contribuer à améliorer nos séjours, partager les attentes des voyageurs et participer ponctuellement à la création de nouvelles expériences, aux côtés de notre équipe de production.

Nous vivons au rythme des saisons. La haute saison privilégie la vente et le suivi des voyageurs ; les périodes plus calmes permettent d'approfondir le marketing et et de contribuer davantage à la production.

Les priorités sont définies ensemble, avec une réelle autonomie dans l'organisation du travail.

🌟 Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous ne recherchons pas un CV parfait ni une personne qui coche toutes les cases.

Nous recherchons surtout une personnalité.

Quelqu'un de curieux, enthousiaste, fiable, qui aime les relations humaines, les défis et le travail bien fait.

Vous pourriez vous reconnaître dans ces quelques phrases :

  • Vous avez une vraie fibre commerciale.

  • Vous connaissez le monde du voyage et savez conseiller des clients exigeants.

  • Vous avez déjà accompagné ou managé une petite équipe.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils numériques, les CRM et les chiffres.

  • Le marketing digital vous intéresse et vous en connaissez les fondamentaux.

  • Vous savez prendre des initiatives, vous organiser et aller au bout de vos projets.

  • Vous aimez la randonnée, le vélo, les voyages ou simplement la découverte de nouveaux territoires.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise en anglais professionnel.

Et surtout, vous avez envie de vous engager dans une entreprise à taille humaine, où votre travail aura un impact visible.

Nous accordons autant d'importance à votre état d'esprit et à vos valeurs qu'à vos compétences.

🌞 Pourquoi rejoindre Nature Occitane ?

✨ Une équipe à taille humaine, passionnée, bienveillante et engagée.

🏕️ Des voyages qui ont du sens, conçus avec soin, au plus près des territoires et de ceux qui les font vivre.

🌊 Un cadre de travail privilégié, entre mer et montagne, dans les Pyrénées-Orientales.

🌱 Une entreprise indépendante et en croissance, où les idées peuvent rapidement devenir des projets concrets.

💡 Une réelle autonomie, de la confiance et la possibilité de proposer, expérimenter et améliorer nos méthodes.


📍 Conditions du poste

  • Prise de poste : à convenir.

✉️ Envie de nous rejoindre ?

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette annonce, nous serions ravis de faire votre connaissance.

Envoyez-nous votre CV, mais surtout quelques mots pour nous expliquer ce qui vous donne envie de rejoindre Nature Occitane.

Pas besoin d'une lettre de motivation interminable ou d'un discours formaté.

Nous préférons une candidature sincère, qui nous permette de comprendre qui vous êtes, ce qui vous anime et ce que vous aimeriez construire avec nous.

Au plaisir de vous rencontrer !
